original_text: THE .md REPORTING CONVENTION IS NOT A CONTRADICTION, resolved: engine/AGENTS.md rule 'Exactly three markdown files: README.md, this file, and status.md. Absolutely no other .md reports' applies to the ENGINE TREE only - engine/ holds exactly those three. The project's analysis write-ups live one level up in 'Claude Science Project Sep 29/results/*.md', a sibling of engine/, which is why both can be true at once. Module prompts must say: no new .md inside engine/, assumptions and sources go in the lib.rs doc comment, status goes in hypothesis.toml (status + one-line summary quoting the report's numbers, the hypothesis's only status record), and write-ups go to project-level results/. Also from AGENTS.md: `make scope H=<name>` fails if a branch touches anything outside hypotheses/<name>/ and must pass before hand-back; `make smoke H=<name>` is the ~1 minute code-path check; `make hypothesis H=<name>` runs at FULL SCALE; changing crates/hypothesis is a core change.
